title: Other HeyGen launch films
what_it_does: Full compositions for Figma, Claude, SpaceX, Codex, Cloud Render, Inspector, Variables and others, with STORYBOARD and HANDOFF files.
when_to_use: Study only: how a 30 to 60 s launch is storyboarded, seam by seam.
why: Code is Apache-2.0 but each film is built around a third-party brand (Claude, Figma, SpaceX), logos, audio and fonts that the NOTICE excludes. Not a part; read the storyboards as a model for our own STORYBOARD format.
